consequence.statement: Existing GRPCRoute resources in v1alpha2 must be migrated to v1; the v1alpha2 API version is no longer served.
consequence.remediation: Install the new GRPCRoute CRD and migrate all v1alpha2 GRPCRoute resources to v1 version before or during the upgrade.

assertion.statement: Gateway API GRPCRoute is moved from v1alpha2 to v1, requiring new CRD installation and migration of existing resources.

checks.detail: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1alpha2 GRPCRoute is not defined by any CRD of the snapshots (the snapshot may not hold every kind of the group)
the API version is not in the snapshots
